data.name: Amnah
data.gender_notes: Amnah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Amnah is derived from the Arabic root 'A-M-N', meaning safety, security, or protection. It is associated with the concept of being free from fear or danger. The name Amnah carries the meaning “Safe, Secure, Protected” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Amnah usually hope their child will grow to embody safe, secure, protected and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, the term 'Amn' is related to the concept of safety and security, reflecting God's attribute of being the Guardian and Protector of believers.
data.etymology: Amnah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Safe, Secure, Protected.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amnah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: أمنة
in_arabic.meaning: أمنة تعني السلام والأمان في اللغة العربية.
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أمنة مشتق من الجذر العربي 'أمن' الذي يعني السلام والأمان. في القرآن الكريم، يرتبط الأمان بالثقة في الله والشعور بالأمن تحت حمايته. تاريخياً، كان اسم أمنة شائعًا بين المسلمين كرمز للأمان والسكينة. وفي الثقافة الإسلامية، يُعتبر اسم أمنة من الأسماء ذات الأهمية الروحية الكبيرة.

in_urdu.name: امنة
in_urdu.meaning: امنة کا مطلب ہے سلامتی اور حفاظت۔
in_urdu.long_meaning: امنة نام عربی جڑ 'أمن' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے سلامتی اور حفاظت۔ قرآن کریم میں، أمن کا تعلق اللہ پر بھروسہ اور اس کی حفاظت کے تحت ہونے کے احساس سے ہے۔ تاریخی طور پر، امنة نام مسلمانوں کے درمیان حفاظت اور سکون کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی روایات میں، امنة نام کو خاص روحانی اہمیت حاصل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अमना
in_hindi.meaning: अमना का अर्थ है शांति और सुरक्षा।
in_hindi.long_meaning: अमना नाम अरबी मूल 'أمن' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है शांति और सुरक्षा। इस्लामी परंपरा में, अमना नाम को आध्यात्मिक महत्व प्राप्त है और यह नाम अक्सर सुरक्षा और शांति के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, अमना नाम को पारंपरिक और महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: امنه
in_pashto.meaning: امنه د سولې او خوندیتوب معنی لري.
in_pashto.long_meaning: د امنه نوم د عربي کلمې 'أمن' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د سولې او خوندیتوب معنی لري. په قرآن کريم کې، د أمن مفهوم د الله پر توکل او د هغه د حفاظت لاندې د امن احساس پورې اړه لري. په پښتني او افغان کلتور کې، امنه نوم د خوندیتوب او سولې د نښې په توګه کارول شوی دی. دا نوم د پښتنو مسلمانانو لپاره ځانګړی روحاني ارزښت لري.

in_english.name: Amnah
in_english.meaning: Amnah means safety, security, and peace.
in_english.long_meaning: The name Amnah is derived from the Arabic root 'أمن' (ʾ-m-n), which conveys the meanings of safety, security, and peace. In the Quran, this root is associated with trust in God and the feeling of being under His protection. Historically, Amnah has been used as a name symbolizing peace and security. In Islamic tradition, Amnah holds significant spiritual importance as a name that embodies tranquility and trust in divine providence. Across Muslim cultures, Amnah remains a popular name reflecting these noble qualities.

data.cultural_impact: The name Amnah reflects the Islamic value of safety, security, and protection, emphasizing the importance of creating a nurturing and peaceful environment for personal growth and development. This name can also serve as a reminder of the role of parents or guardians in providing a safe space for their children to thrive and grow. Historically, Amrah and Amran are mentioned in the Quran and Hadiths, also adding a religious significance to this name.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Amnah holds a deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture as it emphasizes seeking protection and security in the faith and trust in Allah (God). Believers are reminded that true safety and security come from their relationship with their Creator. This name also encourages individuals to provide safety and security to those around them, reflecting the Islamic principle of caring for the collective well-being of the community. Overall, Amnah symbolizes both the importance of personal faith and the responsibility of creating a safe and supportive environment for personal and communal growth.
